merge_kit.composition: 4cc883d + Paolo's 10 uncommitted changes + Magus full main + inventory fix

conflicts_resolved.resolution: union of using directives (System.IO + System.Threading + System.Threading.Tasks)

merge_kit.how_to_apply: Option A: `git fetch <magus-repo> paolo-merge && git merge FETCH_HEAD` on Paolo's 4cc883d+10. Option B: `git am -3 paolo-merge.patch`.
